scope: Visual examination of the actual isolated source renders, three morph pose renders and sagittal context render. No medical specialist acceptance; no new source search; no product files modified.

findings.observation: The rounded apex now reads as a distinct lobe or cap with a circumferential indentation. Elevation exposes a notch and hinge-like local bend, instead of a continuous soft tissue transition.
Top and ventral views retain terminal collars/constrictions. The body remains a generic lofted volume; removing a pointed endpoint did not produce an organic tongue.
The posterior/inferior mass remains generic. In the section context it extends below/behind a separate guide surface without an established mucosal attachment or readable root/floor relationship.
The displayed inferred palate is an open guide surface; it does not establish a finished palatal vault, soft palate, velopharyngeal continuity or tissue thickness.

Tip, dorsum and root images show distinct nonrigid changes. This supports the morph interface demonstration, not realistic biomechanics, contacts or Arabic articulations. Numerical return/export equivalence was not assessed by this review.

recommendation.nextSource: A specialized, coherent anatomical art source; a good static sculpt is acceptable. Retopology and cage/shape-key rigging happen after the form passes review. Do not require a complete pre-rigged head to consider a source.
sampleBeforeFullCommitment: Actual editable small oral unit, not only a beauty render: full tongue including ventral/lateral surfaces and root, readable posterior/inferior floor continuity, upper/lower teeth and gingiva, hard palate and soft-palate/uvular context in one documented frame.
Neutral clay top, lateral, ventral and oblique rotation views; a genuine sagittal section of that same source; no hand-drawn section or shader pretending to expose hidden tissue.

Accept high-detail static sculpture at this stage even with unsuitable animation topology. The geometric anatomy and intended soft tissue boundaries must be clear; quad count and manifold status are separate later checks.

Provenance and explicit modification/web-use rights, including conditions for derived runtime assets and public repository/raw GLB distribution if intended. Record the exact asset and price before any spending commitment.

After form approval, retopologize the small sample and demonstrate independent tip elevation, dorsum elevation, root retraction and return, with intermediate states and contact inspection; then expand the asset.
implementNow: Reuse the existing review renderer and motion interface. Build an asset intake adapter with source/license/units/parts metadata and fixed clay/source-view evidence.

Prepare a non-destructive retopology/cage binding and bake path; convert any unsupported Blender dependence into bones or GLB morph targets. Do not manufacture another candidate anatomical mesh procedurally.

Implement an asset-independent comparison of source versus exported morph poses at endpoints and intermediate weights, including rest return, coupled dentition and meaningful contact/collapse diagnostics.
Keep the rejected pilot solely as an explicitly labelled technical fixture for the import/export and morph controls; do not promote it to the teaching model.

stopRuleApplied: Baseline plus one directed form correction has been used. No third cosmetic/modeling pass is recommended for this pilot. Preserve it as rejected evidence.
